skill_specific_guidance.title: CloudTrail Events Threat Activity Analysis
skill_specific_guidance.rule: Focus on observed CloudTrail event history, not theoretical account configuration gaps.
For every finding, cite the exact event name, actor identity, event time window, and source evidence file when present.
Use TrailDiscover/MITRE context only as enrichment for observed suspicious events; never create a finding from threat intelligence alone.
Distinguish suspicious administration from confirmed attacker activity unless the evidence contains incident indicators.
